title: Search terms
description: content/search-terms.json: our own words people type for a find type, a place or a topic, used by map search. See docs/MAP.md.

examples.description: Example questions, shown as chips under the home page's search band (components/home/AskBar.astro), each a link to /map?q=. One that lists no find on the map (default filters) is left out at build time, and pnpm test fails on it. Short enough for one chip line on a 320px phone.

topics.description: Topic groups: a query word in a group matches any word of the group ("cash" finds "loot"). Keys are our own names.
